definitions.explanation: Studying or learning a subject on one's own, without a teacher or formal instruction.

examples.japanese: ピアノを{独習|どくしゅう}する。
{独習|どくしゅう}でフランス{語|ご}を{身|み}につけた。
この{教材|きょうざい}は{独習|どくしゅう}に{向|む}いているので、{初心者|しょしんしゃ}でも{安心|あんしん}して{使|つか}える。
examples.english: This textbook is suited for self-study, so even beginners can use it with confidence.

notes:
Composed of {独|どく} (alone, self) and {習|しゅう} (learn, study). Emphasizes learning without a teacher.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独習|どくしゅう}で{学|まな}ぶ: to learn through self-study
- {独習|どくしゅう}に{向|む}いている: suited for self-study
- {独習|どくしゅう}{書|しょ}: self-study book
- {独習|どくしゅう}テキスト: self-study textbook
- {独習|どくしゅう}で{身|み}につける: to acquire through self-study

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {独学|どくがく}: self-teaching — very close synonym, slightly more common in conversation
- {独習|どくしゅう}: self-study — slightly more formal, often used in book titles
- {自習|じしゅう}: self-study — studying on one's own, often during a designated study period at school
- {予習|よしゅう}: preparation — studying material before class
- {復習|ふくしゅう}: review — going over material after class
